in_marathi.name: Gaureeshankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gaureeshankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gaureeshankar is a compound name derived from two words: 'Gaur' and 'Ishankar'. Gaur refers to 'God' or 'Lord' and Ishankar refers to 'Lord Shankara', who is a manifestation of Lord Shiva. Thus, Gaureeshankar signifies the 'God of Auspiciousness'.
